mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting pyruvate and oxygen to aerobic ATP renewal was most worthwhile: the planned picture distinguishes fuel oxidation from oxygen's role and shows the hydrogen-ion reservoir driving ATP synthase.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying amino acids at the cell interior was the least productive moment: ribosomes and RNA were already shown there, but the direct combination failed. The compatibility feedback did clarify the available partners.

surprise.text: I expected glucose and oxygen at the cell interior to lead directly to aerobic ATP renewal, but glucose first became pyruvate and ATP without oxygen shown as an input to glycolysis.

arbitrary.text: The amino-acid combination with the cell interior initially felt unclear because the pictured ribosomes were there; the subsequent ATP-partner feedback and protein picture supplied a purpose for the alternative.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose to continue: the constructions connected membrane transport, ATP renewal and protein production in a way that made the next biological question appealing. The planned pictures are informative, though this does not establish how students would understand them.
